pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Run Strap on your own computer, finish setup and find your way around the studio.

pages.title: Put Strap online
pages.summary: Deploy Strap to your own account so members and instructors can sign in from anywhere.

pages.title: Classes and the waitlist
pages.summary: Prepare and publish the week, let members book, fill cancellations from the waitlist and check people in.

pages.title: Packs, credits and payments
pages.summary: Give members class credits, record the payments you receive and see what every member owes.

pages.title: People and access
pages.summary: Add members and instructors, invite them to sign in, and end someone's access at once.

pages.title: Waivers
pages.summary: Publish a waiver version that members acknowledge before they book.

pages.title: Agent access
pages.summary: Let an assistant prepare next week's classes, packs and reminders for you to approve.

pages.title: Integrations
pages.summary: Give another application read-only access to your class rosters, then rotate, revoke and watch its key.

pages.title: Move in from Mindbody
pages.summary: Bring your members across from a CSV: preview it, apply it, and undo it later if you need to.

pages.title: Backup and restore
pages.summary: Export the whole studio to one archive and restore it into a fresh copy of Strap.
